CRM notes (shorthand):
- Mid-market B2B SaaS (helpdesk automation) w/ ~350 engs, global customer base (NA/EU).
- Primary ask: Hosted API for initial deploy (fast time-to-value), evaluate Dedicated after POC for predictable throughput + isolation.
- Latency SLO: target 150-250ms p95 for assistant responses (streaming enabled). Customer cares about tail latency for interactive typing UX.
- Tool calling is core: need deterministic function/tool execution and reliable opaque tool responses (webhook + retry semantics).

- "They liked the streaming demo but asked: 'How do you guarantee the streaming p95 across regions under burst?'"
- Security: SSO (SAML) + KMS for customer keys; audit logging mandatory for procurement.
- Legal: asked for data residency clause + SOC2 evidence; Redwood to provide security FAQ + ISO/SOC artifacts.
- POC scope: 2-week hosted API POC (NA primary, EU secondary) - measure p50/p95, tool-calling reliability, streaming UX, recovery/fallback behavior.
- Success criteria: p95 <=250ms for 95% of sessions, tool-calling success >=99%, fallbacks triggered <1% during baseline test, documented cost per 1M tokens.
- Internal notes: prioritize SE time for N. America latency tuning; provide sample harness (k6+tornado) and sample dataset (anonymized transcripts).
